newsitem.title: USA: Dow extends decline as bonds weaken further.
newsitem.headline: Dow extends decline as bonds weaken further.

text.p: U.S. blue chips resumed their decline late Wednesday afternoon amid a weak performance by U.S. Treasury bonds.

The Dow was down 120 points at 7105, erasing nearly all the gains the blue-chip average tallied early in the week. The Nasdaq Composite also fell as interest rate pressures rose, dipping four points to 1324.
Bonds slipped after a disappointing quarterly refunding auction of 10-year U.S. notes. The benchmark long bond fell 29/32 to yield 6.96 percent.
